verdict.rationale: Poke can generate tables/charts from described data or shared images (poke-docs-21), but there is no evidence of a general code-execution/data-analysis environment (e.g., running scripts on uploaded datasets, generating downloadable computed files) beyond visualization. missing for 10: evidence of arbitrary code execution on user data, support for computed/downloadable file outputs, and handling of larger structured datasets beyond simple chart/table generation.
